requirements.title: PACK argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an array of any type; MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY; optional VECTOR shall have the same type and type parameters as ARRAY, have rank one, and contain enough elements for the true MASK elements or scalar-true ARRAY elements.

pending.PACK-ARRAY-array-any-type: Positive source controls call PACK on rank-two integer and character arrays; a source-control mutation uses a scalar ARRAY and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.PACK-MASK-logical-conformable: Use a rank-two logical MASK with a rank-two ARRAY and a scalar true MASK companion; mutate MASK to nonlogical and to a nonconformable shape without claiming diagnostic coverage.
pending.PACK-VECTOR-same-type-parameters-rank-on: Use VECTOR arrays matching ARRAY type and character length; source-control mutations change VECTOR rank and character length with no diagnostic facet.
pending.PACK-VECTOR-size-covers-selected-element: Use a VECTOR with more elements than selected MASK entries and a scalar-true MASK case sized to ARRAY; source-control mutation shortens VECTOR below the required element count.

requirements.title: PACK result characteristics
requirements.definition: The PACK result has rank one, the same type and type parameters as ARRAY, size equal to VECTOR size with VECTOR present, and otherwise size equal to the true MASK count or to SIZE(ARRAY) for scalar true MASK.

pending.PACK-result-rank-one-same-type-parameter: Assign PACK of a rank-two character array to a rank-one character result with distinct length and assert RANK, LEN, and element values; mutate ARRAY character length or expected rank.
pending.PACK-result-size-from-VECTOR: Call PACK with a VECTOR longer than the selected elements and assert SIZE(result) equals SIZE(VECTOR); mutate VECTOR length so the size check fails.
pending.PACK-result-size-from-MASK-or-ARRAY: Call PACK without VECTOR using a nonscalar MASK with two true elements and a scalar true MASK over a three-element array; assert result sizes two and three with companion element checks. Also use PACK with scalar false MASK and a four-element VECTOR of distinguished values; assert SIZE(result)==SIZE(VECTOR) so the t=0 VECTOR case is covered.

requirements.title: PACK result value follows true MASK elements and VECTOR tail
requirements.definition: Elements selected by true MASK values are packed in array element order, and trailing result elements beyond the true count come from VECTOR.

pending.PACK-selected-elements-array-element-ord: Use a rank-two integer array with distinct values and a MASK selecting nonadjacent elements; assert the packed sequence follows array element order and mutate the MASK or expected order. Also call PACK on the same distinguished rank-two ARRAY with scalar MASK=.true. and no VECTOR; assert the result contains every ARRAY element in array element order.
pending.PACK-vector-tail-elements: Use selected ARRAY elements 9 and 7 with a six-element VECTOR containing nondefault tail sentinels; assert tail positions come from VECTOR and mutate VECTOR order. Also call PACK with scalar MASK=.false. and a VECTOR whose elements are all distinguished from ARRAY; assert the entire result equals VECTOR, covering the tail rule with t=0.
